directions.canonical_title: Inner models, large cardinals and determinacy
directions.title_zh: 内模型、大基数与决定性
directions.regional_relevance: Inner models compare axiomatic set-theoretic universes and large-cardinal/determinacy strength; this is foundational logic, not an application-specific mathematical theory.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The programme explicitly covers new inner-model results, large cardinals, determinacy and forcing axioms. The two weeks are counted as one organized event group.

Steel records two lectures on large cardinals, determinacy and inner models, explicitly limiting the inner-model coverage to the comparison lemma. This is a distinct JMM tutorial, not a mirror of the Vienna workshop.

directions.title_zh: 模型论温和性与 o-极小结构
directions.regional_relevance: Tameness concerns definable sets and types in first-order structures, including o-minimal and weakly o-minimal settings; it lies within model theory.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The meeting studies model-theoretic tameness of groups and fields and related classification questions. Only this short audit summary and bibliographic metadata are redistributed; the restricted report PDF is not copied.
The authors investigate invariant types and weakly o-minimal types, and apply definable shifts to counting models. The current v2, not the search engine's old v1 metadata, is registered.

directions.title_zh: 高阶范畴模型与协调性
directions.regional_relevance: Polygraphs and Segal-space models study higher categorical composition, coherence and homotopical presentation.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: A higher-dimensional rewriting framework develops coherence calculations and a model structure for strict higher categories.
The article constructs higher categories through complete Segal-space fibrations and compares quasi-category constructions. It is independent of the polygraphs monograph.

directions.canonical_title: Cubical type theory and univalent higher structures
directions.title_zh: 立方类型论与单价高阶结构
directions.regional_relevance: Cubical type theory models higher identity and homotopy structures; its primary placement is higher structures with cross-membership in logic and algebraic topology.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The collaborative book supplies the established connection between identity types, homotopy, higher inductive types and univalent foundations.

The paper treats contortion and Kan boundary-filling algorithms for cubical type theories supporting univalence and higher inductive types. It distinguishes heuristic automation from the undecidable general Kan problem.

directions.regional_relevance: Categorification replaces representation-theoretic invariants by categories, with algebra actions and Grothendieck groups linking representation theory and category theory.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The programme discusses categorical representations, KLR algebras and relations between superalgebra categorifications, including research talks about subquotients of category O.
Rui and Song use a Grothendieck group of filtered Brauer-category representations to categorify a highest-weight module, with explicit characteristic restrictions.

directions.canonical_title: Modular representations, blocks and tensor-triangular methods
directions.title_zh: 模表示、块与张量三角方法
directions.regional_relevance: Blocks and defect groups are central to finite-group modular representations; tensor-triangular geometry supplies additional categorical methods.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The article completes the remaining implication of Brauer's height-zero conjecture for odd primes; it supports ongoing study of finite-group blocks and defect groups, not a claim that this named conjecture remains open.
Research talks connect tensor-triangular methods with modular representation theory, homotopy and algebraic geometry. This organized programme is independent of the Brauer article.

directions.canonical_title: Prismatic cohomology and integral p-adic geometry
directions.title_zh: 棱柱上同调与整 p 进几何
directions.regional_relevance: Prismatic sites and crystals connect arithmetic p-adic cohomology with formal-scheme geometry, giving legitimate number-theoretic and algebraic-geometric placements.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: Prismatic sites of p-adic formal schemes unify several integral p-adic cohomology theories. The article's scope is read from its abstract, not its apparently unrelated publisher MSC field.

Tsuji explains a q-Higgs description of prismatic crystals and their cohomology, including Frobenius and Nygaard filtrations. This is a distinct research contribution, not the foundational paper's mirror.

directions.canonical_title: Geometrization of the local Langlands correspondence
directions.title_zh: 局部 Langlands 对应的几何化
directions.regional_relevance: Local Langlands geometrization studies local-field representation parameters via sheaves on geometric stacks, connecting arithmetic, representation theory and algebraic geometry.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The work extends the Fargues–Scholze setting from l-adic to motivic sheaves and addresses independence of l of constructed parameters.
Imai provides a separately authored exposition of Fargues–Scholze geometrization. It is counted as a survey source group, not as an independent proof of the correspondence.

directions.regional_relevance: Birational boundedness studies algebraic varieties, linear systems and controlled singularities; it is separate from the analytic construction of canonical metrics.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The programme addresses birational methods, Cremona groups, K-moduli and mirror symmetry. This node uses its birational content; canonical metrics are a separate geometric direction.
Birkar studies birational boundedness for polarized projective varieties under controlled singularities and positivity hypotheses. The audit does not remove those conditions or verify the proof.

directions.canonical_title: Derived moduli of sheaves and Stokes data
directions.title_zh: 层与 Stokes 数据的导出模空间
directions.regional_relevance: Derived stacks of sheaves and Stokes data belong to algebraic geometry and use higher-categorical coefficients and homotopical constructions.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The paper constructs locally geometric derived moduli of Stokes data. It is the replacement for the derived-moduli portion split out of the older paper; the superseded title is not treated as a second independent work.
Casals and Li construct functions on derived sheaf moduli with Legendrian microsupport using Hochschild homology and geometry of Lagrangian fillings.

directions.title_zh: 色同伦与代数 K 理论
directions.regional_relevance: Chromatic localizations of spectra and redshift questions connect stable algebraic topology and algebraic K-theory; categorical extensions require different hypotheses.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The work characterizes certain Lubin–Tate theories and obtains redshift for algebraic K-theory of E-infinity rings. Ring-spectrum hypotheses are retained in this source audit.
Ramzi studies rigid symmetric-monoidal stable categories and gives counterexamples to a categorical analogue of redshift. This is not a contradiction to the differently scoped ring-spectrum theorem.

directions.regional_relevance: Floer homotopy extracts stable homotopical information from moduli of trajectories, connecting algebraic topology and symplectic geometry.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The seminar progresses from spectra and Morse theory to Floer homotopy, showing a concrete reading and research programme at the intersection of stable homotopy and symplectic topology.

Abouzaid discusses recovering generalized-homology information from higher-dimensional Floer solution spaces and recent technical advances, with further structures explicitly described as work in progress.
